Description: This registry defines the account management messages for Nvidia.

AccountTypeRestricted.Description: Indicates that the requested value/s for the property are not allowed for this account.
AccountTypeRestricted.Message: The requested value/s for the property %1 are not allowed for this account.
AccountTypeRestricted.Resolution: Remove the value/s that are not allowed and resubmit the request.

Name: NVIDIA Account Message Registry
